about_the_game:
Disco Samurai is a unique rhythm combat game set in the cyberpunk city of Disco. Every action you and your enemies take is synchronized to the beat of the music. 

You must master the art of perfectly timed parries and dodges to throw your enemies off balance and finish them off with devastating counter attacks. Miss a beat and you’re dead meat — down here, rhythm isn’t just about style, it’s about survival.

Take the initiative and use the environment to your advantage. Shoot your enemies, kick them into oncoming traffic and smash beer bottles over their heads. Be careful though, as breaking health and safety regulations can go both ways.

Customize your fighting style with 14 unique Keychains that can be attached to your Katana. From improved mobility to enhanced Ability effects to more effective bone-crushing finishers, find the perfect match and show everyone who’s the boss.

  • Unique combat system that combines the best of rhythm and action genres.

  • Collect 14 Keychains to customize your fighting style and enhance favorite Abilities.

  • Story Mode that spans across over 80 hand-crafted dioramas. From oriental gardens to exclusive nightclubs, each of the 7 Chapters offers a different challenge.

  • Test your reflexes in heart-pounding motorcycle chases. Weave through traffic, jump over obstacles and blast bad guys off their bikes.

  • Face dangerous Bosses in epic showdowns. Be patient, precise and utilize every move at your disposal if you want to stand a chance.

  • Custom music support – slay enemies to your favorite tracks!

The world has gone mad for Disco Samurai, a game set in the cyberpunk metaverse known as Disco. Everyone plays it — your neighbor, your boss and probably even your least favorite politician. Not only are people buying virtual real estate, cars and designer clothes, they’re even insuring them! Sounds crazy? You tell me — since the game’s release, the world’s crime rate dropped by over 77%! Why rot in jail for petty crimes, when in Disco you can become a notorious bounty hunter without facing any consequences?

The story follows Fox, a rebellious student who wants to make a name for herself in the world of architecture and fine arts. Since virtual vandalism and spilling pixel blood are more her style than attending lectures, the world of Disco is about to learn a new definition of "brutalism".

content_descriptors.notes: The game revolves around killing enemies on arenas. This results in a mild gore such as blood splatters or blood pools, but gore certainly isn't focus of the game.
